title: Verify-table understates the render suite: 100 tests run, not 99 (6 new tests, not 5)
evidence: _pr_body_viscomm_crisis_duck.md:123: "| `odin test app/render` | 99/99 (94 + 5 new) |" — but `odin test app/render` on this head prints "Finished 100 tests in 14.04ms. All tests were successful." and app/render/palette_polish_test.odin now declares 12 @(test) procs (lines 22,54,63,87,153,185,253,311,325,348,368,427) vs 6 at the merge-base — six new tests, the uncounted sixth being route_tie_inline_load_default_is_pinned.
detail: The mirror/spec verify table is stale by one test; reviewers re-running the suite will see 100, not the documented 99.
recommended_fix: Update the PR-body mirror (and spec verify table) to "100/100 (94 + 6 new)".

title: Desat block inserted between draw_crisis_banner's doc comment and its proc, orphaning the banner doc ~196 lines
evidence: app/render/crisis.odin:69-76 is draw_crisis_banner's doc comment ending "// is live)." ; line 77 immediately starts "// v2-viscomm-crisis-duck (user design ruling 2026-08-25, viscomm audit" and the CRISIS_DESAT_MIX/CRISIS_FADE16/crisis_desat_factor/crisis_recede section follows; `draw_crisis_banner :: proc(v: ^View, crisis: ^pp.Crisis_State, cat: ^pp.Catalogs, era: u8, y_base: i32 = 10) {` sits at line 272 with no adjacent doc.
detail: Every other proc in this file has its doc comment adjacent; the insertion splits the banner's doc from its definition, hurting navigability.
recommended_fix: Move the desat constants/procs below draw_crisis_banner's definition (or above its doc comment) so the banner doc stays adjacent.
